nodes.summary: A family of real numbers $d_n(t)$, indexed by $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and times $t \in \mathbb{N}$, exhibits cutoff if there are real numbers $t_n$ with $t_n \to \infty$ such that for every $\eta$ with $0 < \eta < 1$, as $n \to \infty$, $d_n(\lceil (1+\eta) t_n \rceil) \to 0$ and $d_n(\lfloor (1-\eta) t_n \rfloor) \to 1$. Here the ceiling and floor are taken in $\mathbb{N}$, so a negative argument gives $0$.
nodes.title: Cutoff for a family of distance profiles

nodes.summary: Let $S$ be a finite set, $P$ a real $S \times S$ matrix and $\pi : S \to \mathbb{R}$. Then $P$ is mixed at time $t \in \mathbb{N}$ with respect to $\pi$ if for every $x \in S$ the total variation distance $\frac{1}{2} \sum_{y \in S} |P^t(x, y) - \pi(y)|$ between the row $x$ of the matrix power $P^t$ and $\pi$ is at most $1/4$.
nodes.title: Being $1/4$-mixed at a given time

nodes.summary: For a simple graph $G$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ and a colouring $\sigma$ of its vertices with colours in $\{0, \dots, q-1\}$, this is the number of edges $uv$ of $G$ with $\sigma_u = \sigma_v$, as a real number, each edge counted once.
nodes.title: Number of monochromatic edges

nodes.summary: The sign of a Boolean spin is the real number $+1$ if the spin is true and $-1$ if it is false.
nodes.title: Sign of a Boolean spin

nodes.summary: For a vertex $x$ of the discrete torus $\mathbb{Z}_n^d$ and a coordinate $k \in \{0, \dots, d-1\}$, the neighbour $x + e_k$ is obtained from $x$ by replacing its $k$-th coordinate $x_k$ by $(x_k + 1) \bmod n$ and leaving the other coordinates unchanged.
nodes.title: Coordinate step on the discrete torus

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $d$ and $n$, the vertices of the discrete torus $\mathbb{Z}_n^d$ are the functions from $\{0, \dots, d-1\}$ to $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$, that is, the $d$-tuples of residues modulo $n$.
nodes.title: Discrete torus

nodes.summary: For real-valued functions $\mu$ and $\nu$ on a finite set $S$, their total variation distance is $\frac{1}{2} \sum_{y \in S} |\mu(y) - \nu(y)|$.
nodes.title: Total variation distance of functions on a finite set

nodes.summary: For a real $S \times S$ matrix $Q$ indexed by a finite set $S$, a function $\pi : S \to \mathbb{R}$ and $x \in S$, this is the total variation distance $\frac{1}{2} \sum_{y \in S} |Q(x, y) - \pi(y)|$ of the row $x$ of $Q$ from $\pi$.
nodes.title: Total variation distance of a matrix row from a function

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
